segments.text: Open Chronicle is a self-hosted interaction engine that makes your LLM conversations durable. Persistent long-term memory, deterministic tasking,
and fully auditable decision trails injected directly into your workflow.
Totally provider agnostic. Plug in any model you want. Seamlessly supports your local CLI, Discord bots, and MCP servers out of the box.
